description: 8-intent taxonomy derived empirically from 50 frozen development customer conversations (Phase 2 v2). Frozen prior to inspecting evaluation pool messages.

intents.name: Content Availability & Licensing
intents.description: Inquiries regarding missing, removed, unavailable, or upcoming songs, albums, artists, or podcasts, including regional catalog licensing differences.

includes: Questions asking why a specific song, album, or artist is missing or greyed out
Inquiries about regional music rights or country-specific catalog restrictions
Upcoming music or album release dates (e.g., requests to add new albums)
Questions asking why songs were removed from an existing playlist or album
excludes: Technical playback failures where a track exists but won't play audio (technical_support)
Service availability in an entire country (platform_and_regional)

typical_examples: why AM to PM by Christina Milian is not available on US Spotify?!?
missing some songs by Children of Bodom. Not available for Spain users?
why do you guys keep removing songs from certain albums
put out #reputation on Spotify

intents.name: Technical Support & App Performance
intents.description: Inquiries reporting software bugs, playback failures, crashes, audio glitches, sync issues, offline download problems, or app update regressions.

includes: Audio playback not working, tracks refusing to play, or GUI freezing
Bugs or crashes on mobile, desktop, or web players
Bugs introduced by recent app updates (e.g., timestamp restart issues)
Desktop player synchronization delays or podcast feed refresh delays
UI rendering bugs such as cutoff text or misaligned elements
excludes: Playback blocked due to concurrent listening on the same Family account (subscription_and_plans)
Voice control issues specific to third-party smart speakers (platform_and_regional)
Tracks withheld due to licensing rights (content_availability)

tracks ive downloaded do not respond when I hit play. The GUI presses but no sound.
Too bad shuffle doesn't work on mobile.
recent update won't let me switch songs without starting the next at the time stamp from the previous
podcasts like take so long to show up in my Windows desktop player
weird bug where the total amount of songs is cutoff
This message on everything I try to play. Nothing works. FAQs no help at all.

intents.name: Account Access & Security
intents.description: Issues logging in, resetting passwords, recovering accounts after third-party SSO (e.g. Facebook) disconnection, or reporting compromised/hacked accounts.

includes: Inability to log in, forgotten passwords, or password reset loops
Loss of access following Facebook account deletion or disconnection
Reports of compromised, hacked, or unauthorized access to an account
Contact form login-wall catch-22 (cannot log in to contact support)
excludes: Wanting to permanently delete or close an account (subscription_and_plans)
Updating account address or billing details (subscription_and_plans or billing_and_payments)

typical_examples: deleted my Facebook account and now cannot access my spotify account. Help.
hi my premium account has been hacked. How may I proceed from here? Thanks.
I deleted my Facebook account without realising my Spotify account was connected. Now I can't access my Spotify account

I cant change my password and if I try to contact you; it makes me sign in, and I dont know my password

intents.name: Billing, Payments & Invoicing
intents.description: Disputes or inquiries about charges, recurring payment methods, payment schedules, refund requests, missing premium status despite payment, grace periods, or billing cancellation timing.

includes: Unexpected charges, unauthorized charges, or promotional partner disputes (e.g., Hulu student discount)
Repeated requests to update payment info every month
Charged for Premium but the account remains on Free tier
Timing of monthly payment deductions vs paycheck
Requests for grace periods or payment extensions
Billing status inquiries upon cancelling a free trial
excludes: Upgrades/downgrades between plan tiers like Family or Student (subscription_and_plans)
Complaints about general subscription pricing or free tier ads (product_feedback)

typical_examples: what's up with me having to update my payment info every month? It's getting annoying.

intents.name: Subscription & Plan Management
intents.description: Questions regarding Spotify plan types (Family, Student, Duo, Individual), managing Family plan invites and members, account address verification, plan upgrades/downgrades, or account deletion.

includes: Issues joining, inviting, or configuring members on a Family plan
Multiple concurrent playback conflicts between Family plan members
Account address or country change restrictions for family accounts
Requests to permanently delete or close a Spotify account
Family account restoration when membership expires or drops
excludes: Inability to log in to an existing account (account_access)
Direct disputes over a specific monetary charge or receipt (billing_and_payments)

intents.name: Platform Compatibility & Regional Availability
intents.description: Inquiries regarding Spotify service availability in specific countries/regions, travel/roaming restrictions, or integration with external hardware/operating systems (e.g., Sonos, Apple Watch, Siri, Windows UWP).

includes: Inquiries asking when Spotify will launch in a country (e.g., India, Iraq, South Africa)
Restrictions on listening while traveling abroad (e.g., 14-day travel rule in Dubai)
Hardware or OS platform integrations (e.g., Apple Watch, Siri, Sonos voice control, Windows UWP)
Inquiries asking if a specific device ecosystem is supported
excludes: Licensing of specific artists/albums in a country where Spotify is already active (content_availability)
General app bugs or crashes on supported devices (technical_support)

intents.name: Product Feedback, Suggestions & UX Complaints
intents.description: Feature requests, UI/UX feedback, comments on recommendation algorithms (e.g., Discover Weekly), ad frequency/placement complaints, or general user experience feedback.

includes: Suggestions for new app features or filters (e.g., 'most played' filter, airplane mode detection)
Feedback or complaints regarding playlist recommendations (e.g., memes in Discover Weekly, unwanted recommended songs in playlists)
Complaints about ad frequency, volume, or placement (e.g., ad playing mid-song on free tier)
Discontent with free tier feature limitations without seeking technical help
Public artist display requests or listener count corrections
excludes: Actual software defects or reproducible bugs (technical_support)
Inquiries about specific song licensing or missing catalog (content_availability)

intents.name: Other, Social Banter & Ambiguous
intents.description: Messages that lack actionable support requests, including compliments/praise, casual banter, jokes, vague or uninterpretable complaints requiring external media (images/links), fandom commentary, or spam.

includes: Expressions of gratitude or praise without an open issue
Casual jokes, banter, or meta-questions (e.g., 'what's a DM?')
Messages consisting solely of links/images with vague captions ('Please explain yourself!!')
Celebrity fandom spam or hashtags without an actionable user issue
General solicitation of free perks or giveaways
Commentary about customer service quality in the abstract
excludes: Inquiries with a clear troubleshooting request, even if accompanied by a screenshot (classify by the text request)
Vague complaints that can be resolved using prior conversation context
